theme_and_archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Sacred Accessibility. Light Theme default, full Dark Mode support.
app_context: Tablet-first hybrid app (React Native Expo) for elderly, visually-impaired Catholic priests.

fonts.reading: Merriweather, serif (or similar high-legibility serif for Missal text)
fonts.ui_controls: Inter, sans-serif (for buttons, menus, and navigation)

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 7:1 (WCAG AAA) for all reading text

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 64x64px padding for all interactive elements. NO small buttons.
spacing_and_layout.margins: Generous margins (p-6 md:p-12) to prevent accidental edge touches.
spacing_and_layout.layout_mode: Single-column continuous reading view. Max-width 800px on tablet landscape for optimal line tracking.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Sticky bottom or top navigation bar with massive icons (32px+) and bold text labels.

components_instructions.buttons: Large blocks, solid high-contrast backgrounds, rounded-lg (8px), thick 2px borders. Must have distinct active/pressed states.
components_instructions.cards: Flat design, thick 2px border (border-border), no soft shadows or glassmorphism. High visual clarity.
components_instructions.segmented_controls: Used for choosing A/B/C options (e.g., Atto Penitenziale). Massive tap areas, distinct selected state (e.g., solid fill vs outline).
components_instructions.text_slider: Prominent 'A-' and 'A+' buttons in the reading view header or settings modal.
components_instructions.liturgical_indicator: A colored bar or large dot indicating the current liturgical season (Green, Purple, etc.).

motion_and_interactions.animations: Extremely minimal. Simple fade-ins. Pre-fers reduced motion by default. No complex gestures.
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Continuous vertical scroll for the Missal text. Avoid horizontal swiping for page turns to prevent confusion for elderly users with shaky hands.

images.description: Black leather Bible texture for the loading/splash screen

media.icons: Lucide React (must use stroke-width 2.5 or 3 for high visibility)

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

specific_app_flow.home: Top bar: Settings (Theme, Font Size), Current Liturgical Date. Content: Huge cards for 'Messa di Oggi' (Mass of the Day) and 'Calendario Liturgico'.
specific_app_flow.reading_view: Top sticky header with current section (e.g., 'Gloria'). Main body: continuous scroll of fixed parts + dynamic daily readings. Dropdowns or segmented controls inline for selecting Prefaces/Eucharistic Prayers.
specific_app_flow.rubrics: Liturgical instructions (rubrics) MUST be visually distinct—typically smaller, italicized, and red (hence 'rubrics').
